median_definition: Median of every non-null positive daily PE_TTM observation in the five-year window; excludes current unfinished session. Not median of annual medians.
current_price_method: Separate current intraday point: latest actual price * current total shares / TTM parent-attributable net profit. Current point is not included in historical statistics.

historical_denominator_transition.note: Q3 disclosed on SSE after market close 2026-10-29 (official nominal announcement date 2026-10-30), and historical PE denominator changes on 2026-10-30. This checked transition is consistent with disclosure timing.

lookahead_limitations: No introduced look-ahead from applying today EPS to historical prices; PE_TTM supplied natively by historical source.

Supplier historical financial restatement/vintage conventions have not been independently audited. Do not label this series as fully point-in-time verified or suitable for unbiased backtests without further audit.
price_policy: CLOSE_PRICE is unadjusted actual historical close; independent price chart can use forward adjustment, but its label and dividend effects must be explicit.
